headlines.description: THREE FRIDAY THE 13THS… graced the 2026 calendar, which meant that the Winchester Mystery House had an especially busy year. There’s always something eerily afoot when the 13th day of the month coincides with the final day of the week, including opportunities to roam the rambling mansion’s passageways with only a flashlight casting a beam. But the legendary San Jose abode, a multi-room palace that rose and rose under the watchful eye of Sarah Winchester, also observes a busy December. And that will be the case in 2026 when a few festive and not-so-frightful happenings settle into the Victorian grounds and home, all to give visitors the opportunity to shop, raise a cup of tea, and soak in the vintage yuletide stylings that are synonymous with the colossal property. REVELERS WON’T HAVE TO WAIT, in fact, for a few of the attraction’s seasonally inspired gatherings will begin to “haunt” the destination in late November. The Yuletide Oddities Market will begin its month-long engagement Nov. 28, and if you’ve got an admission to the house your entry is free. No house ticket? You can still call upon the market, which will be full of frightful and fantastical and vintage-pretty finds, for $5. A Holiday Open House later in December is happening on select dates, if you’d like to behold some of the abode’s splendid decorations, while a Christmas Tea Party near the end of November raises a cup, in cheery and slightly eerie fashion, to the season. For everything flowering, like a fog-white poinsettia flower, at the Winchester Mystery House this yuletide, click here.
